title: Receipt upload troubleshooting
approved_steps: Confirm that the file uses an approved format.
Confirm that the file is within the documented size limit.
Ask the customer to retry using the supported upload workflow.
Escalate if the approved steps do not resolve the issue.

title: Possible duplicate invoice review
approved_steps: Compare the invoice reference, supplier, amount, and date using authorized records.
Check whether an existing duplicate warning was acknowledged.
Do not change or release a payment from Signal.
Escalate discrepancies to an authorized accounts-payable reviewer.

title: Approval workflow troubleshooting
approved_steps: Confirm the documented approval path for the tenant without changing it.
Check whether the expected approver has an active authorized role.
Review the workflow status and timestamps available to the support role.
Escalate policy or permission changes to the authorized administrator.

title: Account access troubleshooting
approved_steps: Use the approved identity-verification process before discussing account access.
Confirm that the user is assigned to the correct tenant and authorized role.
Do not request a password, authentication code, or recovery secret.
Escalate suspected compromise through the security process.

title: Integration synchronization troubleshooting
approved_steps: Confirm the affected integration and the time of the last successful synchronization.
Check the approved integration-health indicators available to support.
Do not request or expose API keys or other credentials.
Escalate persistent failures to the integration support owner.
